ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from modifying primary quotes once they are rejected, enforcing the creation of a new quote version for re-approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Residential_Sales", NOT(ISNEW()), IsSyncing = TRUE, ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Rejected") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Primary Quote has been rejected and is locked to preserve the approval history. Please create a new Quote to submit for approval.
